not_found.name: Unknown
description: ## Error
Unable to find the requested arcanum.

accurate_strike.name: Accurate Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Accurate Strike (Ex):]{icon=touch swift="The magus can expend 2 points from his arcane pool to resolve all of his melee weapon attacks until the end of his turn as melee touch attacks." prereq="9th-level magus"}

aquatic_agility.name: Aquatic Agility
description: ‹SOURCE Blood of the Moon/21›

::ab[Aquatic Agility (Su):]{icon=magic immediate="The magus can spend 1 point from his arcane pool to gain the benefits of ‹spell/water breathing› for 1 round per level. During this time, he can ignore the effects of ‹skill/swim>«rough water› and ‹rule/underwater combat› on his attacks and movement." prereq="6th-level magus"}

arcane_accuracy.name: Arcane Accuracy
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Arcane Accuracy (Su):]{icon=boost swift="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to grant himself an insight bonus equal to his Intelligence bonus on all attack rolls until the end of his turn."}

arcane_cloak.name: Arcane Cloak
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Arcane Cloak (Su):]{icon=def ability="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to add his Intelligence bonus to ‹skill/Stealth› checks and ‹skill/Bluff› checks to create a diversion in order to hide. This bonus lasts for 1 minute."}

arcane_dealer.name: Arcane Dealer
description: ‹SOURCE The Harrow Handbook/24›

::ab[Arcane Dealer (Su):]{icon=power-ranged ability="The magus gains the ‹feat/Deadly Dealer› feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites. He can use his arcane pool to grant a ‹eq-misc/deck of cards› an enhancement bonus as though it were a ranged weapon with 54 pieces of ammunition. The magus must use either ‹feat/Arcane Strike› or his arcane pool to enhance the cards in order to use them as weapons." prereq="6th-level magus"}

arcane_deed.name: Arcane Deed
description: ‹SOURCE Advanced Class Guide/104›

::ab[Arcane Deed (Ex):]{icon=power choice="When a magus takes this arcana, he can pick any one ‹ability/swashbuckler_>deed<s› from the swashbuckler class feature as long as that deed can be used by a swashbuckler of his magus level." ability="The magus can use that deed by using points from his arcane pool as the panache points required for that deed. Even if he gains a panache pool through another means, the magus is not considered to have at least 1 point in his panache pool for the purpose of deeds selected with *arcane deed,* and his effective swashbuckler level for determining such a deed's effect is 0." order=ca special="A magus can take this arcana multiple times, each time gaining a new deed." prereq="‹arcana/Flamboyant arcana›"}

arcane_edge.name: Arcane Edge
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Arcane Edge (Su):]{icon=boost immediate="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool after hitting a target with a slashing or piercing weapon in order to deal an amount of ‹rule/bleed› damage equal to his Intelligence modifier (minimum 0)." prereq="9th-level magus"}

arcane_redoubt.name: Arcane Redoubt
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Arcane Redoubt (Su):]{icon=def swift="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to treat his shield bonus to AC (including any enhancement bonus) as a bonus to touch AC until the beginning of his next turn."}

arcane_redoubt_greater.name: Greater Arcane Redoubt
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Greater Arcane Redoubt (Su):]{icon=def ability="Whenever the magus uses his ‹arcana/arcane redoubt› magus arcana, he may spend an additional point from his arcane pool in order to apply his shield bonus to AC (including any enhancement bonus) as a bonus on Reflex saves until the beginning of his next turn." immediate="If he is targeted with an effect requiring a Reflex save while using this power, he may spend 2 points from his arcane pool to grant himself ‹ability/evasion›, or 4 points to grant himself ‹talent/improved evasion›." order=ai prereq="‹arcana/Arcane redoubt›, 12th-level magus"}

arcane_scent.name: Arcane Scent
description: ‹SOURCE Blood of the Moon/21›

::ab[Arcane Scent (Ex):]{icon=power ability="The magus can sniff out other spellcasters. By spending 1 point from his arcane pool, the magus gains the ‹umr/scent› special quality for 1 hour per magus level. This scent can only detect creatures capable of casting spells or using spell-like abilities." move="Additionally, while this effect persists, the magus can attempt a Spellcraft check to determine the highest level spell a detected creature is capable of casting (DC = 10 + the creature's caster level). The magus can only attempt this Spellcraft check once per creature per 24 hours." order=am}

bane_blade.name: Bane Blade
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Bane Blade (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he may spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add the ‹magic-enh/bane› special ability to the weapon." prereq="15th-level magus"}

book_bound.name: Book-Bound
description: ‹SOURCE Disciple's Doctrine/9›

::ab[Book-Bound (Su):]{icon=def immediate="As long as he wields his spellbook in his off hand, the magus can gain a +4 bonus on a ‹rule/concentration› check he attempts within the next round. This bonus stacks with other bonuses, including the bonus from the ‹arcana/concentrate› arcana." usage="3 times/day"}

broad_study.name: Broad Study
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Broad Study (Ex):]{icon=power order=ca choice="The magus selects another one of his spellcasting classes." ability="The magus can use his *spellstrike* and *spell combat* abilities while casting or using spells from the spell list of that class." special="This does not allow him to cast arcane spells from that class's spell list without suffering the normal chances of arcane spell failure, unless the spell lacks somatic components." prereq="6th-level magus, levels in at least one other spellcasting class"}

circle_of_order.name: Circle of Order
description: ‹SOURCE Disciple's Doctrine/9›

::ab[Circle of Order (Su):]{icon=def swift="The magus can spend 1 point from his arcane pool to fortify his defenses against chaotic attacks. This grants him a dodge bonus to his AC equal to ‹misc/half› his magus level against chaotic-aligned attacks and effects and outsiders with the chaotic subtype until the beginning of his next turn. (For example, the magus would gain the dodge bonus against attacks from an ‹magic-enh/anarchic› weapon or a ‹monster/glabrezu«'s› pincers.)" prereq="9th-level magus"}

close_range.name: Close Range
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Close Range (Ex):]{icon=touch ability="The magus can deliver ray spells that feature a ranged touch attack as melee touch spells. He can use a ranged touch attack spell that targets more than one creature (such as ‹spell/scorching ray›), but he makes only one melee touch attack to deliver one of these ranged touch effects; additional ranged touch attacks from that spell are wasted and have no effect." special="These spells can be used with the *spellstrike* class feature."}

concentrate.name: Concentrate
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Concentrate (Ex):]{icon=roll-boost ability="The magus can reroll any ‹rule/concentration› check he has just made with a +4 bonus. He must use this ability after the roll is made, but before the roll's outcome is determined. The magus must take the second roll, even if it is worse." usage="Once per day"}

critical_strike.name: Critical Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Critical Strike (Su):]{icon=power-magic ability="Whenever the magus scores a critical hit with a melee weapon, he may cast a spell with a range of touch as a @HLswift_action, then make a touch attack with that spell against the target of the critical hit as a @HLfree_action." usage="Once per day" prereq="12th-level magus"}

dark_shifter.name: Dark Shifter
description: ‹SOURCE Ranged Tactics Toolbox/13;Bastards of Golarion/9›

::ab[Dark Shifter (Su):]{icon=magic move="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to change the target of an ongoing spell effect with the darkness descriptor. The new target must be within the spell's original range, and uses the magus's level as the effective caster level for the purpose of determining the maximum distance the effect can be moved from the magus.~~~If the spell effect the magus is moving originated from another creature, the magus must succeed at a caster level check to reposition the effect (DC = 11 + the effect's caster level). Failure wastes the magus's move action, but doesn't expend the point from his arcane pool." prereq="6th-level magus"}

devoted_blade.name: Devoted Blade
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Devoted Blade (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he may spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add either the ‹magic-enh/anarchic›, ‹magic-enh/axiomatic›, ‹magic-enh/holy›, or ‹magic-enh/unholy› special ability to the list of available options. A magus may only add one of these abilities if it matches his own alignment." prereq="12th-level magus"}

dispelling_strike.name: Dispelling Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Dispelling Strike (Su):]{icon=magic swift="The magus can spend 1 or more points from his arcane pool to imbue his weapon with a special power. If the weapon strikes a creature within the next minute, that creature is the subject of a targeted ‹spell/dispel magic› using the magus's level as the caster level, except that this effect cannot dispel a spell of a level higher than the number of arcane pool points expended to activate this ability (treat higher-level spells as if they do not exist and apply the dispel attempt to the remaining spells with the highest caster level). Once the strike is made, the power dissipates, even if the dispel attempt is unsuccessful." prereq="9th-level magus"}

disruptive.name: Disruptive
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›
::ab[Disruptive (Ex):]{icon=power ability="The magus gains ‹feat/Disruptive› as a bonus feat." prereq="6th-level magus"}

distant_spellstrike.name: Distant Spellstrike
description: ‹SOURCE Heroes of the Streets/11›

::ab[Distant Spellstrike (Su):]{icon=ranged ability="The range of any spell the magus delivers through a ranged weapon attack increases to the maximum range of the weapon if that is greater than the spell's range." prereq="12th-level magus, *ranged spellstrike* (‹arc-magus/Eldritch Archer› or ‹arc-magus/Myrmidarch›)"}

divinatory_strike.name: Divinatory Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Magical Marketplace/4›

::ab[Divinatory Strike (Su):]{icon=power ability="Whenever the magus scores a critical hit against an opponent with a melee attack, he can gain preternatural insight into his foe's strengths and weaknesses as though he had rolled a natural 20 on a ‹skill/Knowledge› check to identify the creature struck. Any bonuses or penalties the magus normally applies to such a Knowledge check are applied to this ability, including his Intelligence modifier, ranks in the requisite Knowledge skill, and other applicable modifiers." special="Depending on the final calculated outcome of this ability and the CR of the creature struck, the magus may still be unable to glean information about his enemy. This ability works even if the magus has already attempted a Knowledge check to identify the creature."}

empowered_magic.name: Empowered Magic
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/11›

::ab[Empowered Magic (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can cast one spell per day as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Empower Spell› feat. This does not increase the casting time or the level of the spell." prereq="6th-level magus"}

enduring_blade.name: Enduring Blade
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Enduring Blade (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus enchants his weapon using his arcane pool, he may spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to increase the duration to 1 minute per magus level." prereq="6th-level magus"}

familiar.name: Familiar
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Familiar (Ex):]{icon=power ability="The magus gains a ‹sidekick/familiar›, using his magus level as his effective wizard level. This familiar follows the rules for ‹ability/familiars› presented in the *arcane bond* wizard class feature."}

flamboyant_arcana.name: Flamboyant Arcana
description: ‹SOURCE Advanced Class Guide/104›

::ab[Flamboyant Arcana:]{icon=power ability="A magus gains the ‹swashdeed/derring-do› and ‹swashdeed/opportune parry and riposte› deeds from the swashbuckler's list of deeds. The magus can spend only points from his arcane pool (not panache points) to use these deeds and any other deeds he gains from the ‹arcana/arcane deed› arcana. He can't use points from his arcane pool to use deeds from other classes or those gained by feats, nor can he regain points to his arcane pool as a swashbuckler would regain panache points." special="Effects that add to, reduce the cost of, or otherwise affect panache or grit don't affect the arcane pool of a magus with this arcana."}

ghost_blade.name: Ghost Blade
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Ghost Blade (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus enchants his weapon using his arcane pool, he may spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add the ‹magic-enh/brilliant energy› and ‹magic-enh/ghost touch› special abilities to the list of available options." prereq="9th-level magus"}

hasted_assault.name: Hasted Assault
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Hasted Assault (Su):]{icon=boost swift="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to move more quickly. This functions as ‹spell/haste›, but only targets the magus and lasts for a number of rounds equal to the magus's Intelligence bonus." prereq="9th-level magus"}

intuitive_protection.name: Intuitive Protection
description: ‹SOURCE Monster Summoner's Handbook/9›

::ab[Intuitive Protection (Sp):]{icon=def ability="When a conjuration (summoning) spell is cast by an opponent and the magus successfully identifies the spell with a ‹skill/Spellcraft› check, he can spend 1 point form his arcane pool as an @HLimmediate_action to cast ‹spell/protection from chaos, evil, good,« or» law› (chosen when using this ability) on himself; this lasts a number of rounds equal to his magus level." imp7="He can instead cast ‹spell/magic circle against chaos, evil, good,« or» law› when using this ability." prereq="3rd-level magus"}

ki_arcana.name: Ki Arcana
description: ‹SOURCE Magical Marketplace/4›

::ab[Ki Arcana (Ex):]{icon=power ability="The magus may use points from his arcana pool and ki points from a *ki pool* granted by another class interchangeably." prereq="6th-level magus, levels in a class that grants him a *ki pool*"}

lingering_pain.name: Lingering Pain
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Lingering Pain (Su):]{icon=lower immediate="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool after hitting a target with a weapon attack. All damage from that attack (including damage from a spell cast using the spellstrike ability) is considered continuous damage for the purposes of any ‹rule/concentration› checks made by the target prior to the beginning of the magus's next turn."}

maneuver_mastery.name: Maneuver Mastery
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Maneuver Mastery (Ex):]{icon=melee order=cp flavor="The magus has mastered one ‹rule/combat maneuver›." choice="He selects one maneuver when selecting this arcana." passive="Whenever he is attempting the selected maneuver, he uses his magus level in place of his base attack bonus (in addition to any base attack bonus gained from other classes)." special="A magus can select this magus arcana more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time he selects this arcana, he selects another combat maneuver."}

maximized_magic.name: Maximized Magic
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Maximized Magic (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can cast one spell per day as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Maximize Spell› feat. This does not increase the casting time or the level of the spell." prereq="12th-level magus"}

natural_spell_combat.name: Natural Spell Combat
description: ‹SOURCE Blood of the Moon/21›

::ab[Natural Spell Combat (Ex):]{icon=melee-boost ability="The magus can use his *spell combat* class feature with a ‹rule/natural attack› of his choice. If he does, he gains a +2 bonus on ‹rule/concentration› checks.~~~If the natural attack is made with an appendage that would normally hold a weapon (such as a claw attack), the magus cannot wield a weapon in that appendage while making natural attacks with it. If the natural attack is a bite or other attack that does not require a free appendage to make, the magus can use the natural attack in addition to all of the attacks he could make with his melee weapon, if he has one." special="A magus can select this arcana more than once. The bonus on concentration checks does not stack.~~~Each time he selects this arcana, he selects another natural weapon. For example, a magus could select this arcana twice, choosing claw attacks and bite attacks. This would allow him to use a full-round action to make all of his claw attacks with his free hand and all of his bite attacks in addition to casting a spell.~~~This arcana otherwise functions exactly like the *spell combat* class feature."}

planar_hunter.name: Planar Hunter
description: ‹SOURCE Monster Summoner's Handbook/9›

::ab[Planar Hunter (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he can spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add the ‹magic-enh/planar› special ability to his weapon, or 2 additional points to add the ‹magic-enh/phase locking› special ability." prereq="9th-level magus"}

pool_ray.name: Pool Ray
description: ‹SOURCE Ranged Tactics Toolbox/13›

::ab[Pool Ray:]{icon=ranged standard="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to infuse a ranged weapon with elemental power." order=sf free="While making an attack roll with the infused ranged weapon, after the attack roll has been made but before the results are revealed by the GM, the magus can release the charge and cause his attack to deal 1d6 points of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, or fire, chosen when he spends the arcane pool point to activate this ability). If he misses with this attack, the charge is lost and the effect is wasted." special="If the magus has the *ranged spellstrike* class feature (such as through the ‹arc-magus/Myrmidarch› archetype), he can use this ability with *ranged spellstrike* to treat it as its own ranged touch attack." incrementPlain="The damage~3~3" incrementEnd="d6."}

pool_strike.name: Pool Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Pool Strike (Su):]{icon=touch standard="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool to charge his free hand with energy. He can make a melee touch attack with that hand as a @HLfree_action as part of activating this ability. If the touch attack hits, it releases the charge and deals 2d6 points of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, or fire, chosen when he spends the arcane pool point to activate this ability)." special="He can use this ability with the *spellstrike* class feature. If he misses with this attack, he can hold the charge for up to 1 minute before it dissipates." incrementPlain="The damage~3~3~3~1" incrementEnd="d6."}

pool_strike_arcing.name: Arcing Pool Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Arcing Pool Strike (Su):]{icon=zap ability="The magus can expend 1 additional point from his arcane pool when using the ‹arcana/pool strike› arcana. If his attack hits, the magus can target a number of enemies within 15 feet equal to his Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) with a ranged touch attack as a @HLfree_action. Those struck take the same energy damage as the primary target of the pool strike, including increased damage on a critical hit." prereq="12th-level magus, ‹arcana/pool strike›"}

pool_strike_clinging.name: Clinging Pool Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/54›

::ab[Clinging Pool Strike (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can expend 1 additional point from his arcane pool when making a ‹arcana/pool strike›. A single target of his pool strike takes energy damage as normal from the pool strike and also takes half this amount of damage at the beginning of its turn on the following round." prereq="9th-level magus, ‹arcana/pool strike›"}

pool_strike_thunderous.name: Thunderous Pool Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55›

::ab[Thunderous Pool Strike (Su):]{icon=boost-lower ability="The magus can expend 1 additional point from his arcane pool when making a ‹arcana/pool strike›. His pool strike deals sonic damage and ‹misc/deafen«s› a single target for 1 round (DC 10 + 1/2 magus level + Intelligence modifier)." prereq="6th-level magus, ‹arcana/pool strike›"}

prescient_attack.name: Prescient Attack
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55›

::ab[Prescient Attack (Su):]{icon=lower immediate="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool after hitting a target with a weapon attack, allowing him to anticipate his opponent's defenses. The target is denied its Dexterity bonus against the magus's attacks until the end of the magus's next turn." prereq="6th-level magus"}

prescient_defense.name: Prescient Defense
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55›

::ab[Prescient Defense (Su):]{icon=def immediate="The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool after hitting a target with a weapon attack, granting him a premonition of his enemy's intentions. The magus gains a bonus to his AC and on Reflex saves equal to his Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) against attacks by that opponent until the beginning of his next turn." prereq="9th-level magus"}

quickened_magic.name: Quickened Magic
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Quickened Magic (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can cast one spell per day as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Quicken Spell› feat. This does not increase the level of the spell." prereq="15th-level magus"}

rakshasas_fortune.name: Rakshasa's Fortune
description: ‹SOURCE The Harrow Handbook/25›

::ab[Rakshasa's Fortune (Su):]{icon=boost-down free="Whenever the magus casts a spell of the polymorph subschool on himself, he can draw a card from a complete ‹eq-misc/harrow deck› he owns. If the card's alignment and the magus's alignment are a true match, the spell's duration is doubled and the magus can select two additional monster abilities granted by the polymorph spell (such as ‹umr/scent› or ‹umr/grab› for ‹spell/beast shape II›), even if the form assumed by the magus doesn't normally grant that ability.~~~On a partial match, the magus can select an additional ability granted by the polymorph spell, even if the form assumed by the magus doesn't normally grant that ability.~~~On an opposite match, the duration of the spell is halved and the magus must forgo one of the abilities granted by his form." prereq="9th-level magus"}

ranger_trap.name: Ranger Trap
description: ‹SOURCE Ranged Tactics Toolbox/13›
::ab[Ranger Trap:]{icon=power ability="The magus learns a ‹ability/ranger trap<s›." prereq="10th-level magus"}

reach_magic.name: Reach Magic
description: ‹SOURCE Ranged Tactics Toolbox/13›
::ab[Reach Magic:]{icon=boost ability="The magus can cast one spell per day as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Reach Spell› feat. This doesn't increase the spell's casting time or level."}

reach_spellstrike.name: Reach Spellstrike
description: ‹SOURCE Heroes of the Streets/11›

::ab[Reach Spellstrike (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can deliver spells with a range of touch with *ranged spellstrike* up to a maximum range of close (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 caster levels)." prereq="9th-level magus, *ranged spellstrike* (‹arc-magus/Eldritch Archer› or ‹arc-magus/Myrmidarch›)"}

reflection.name: Reflection
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Reflection (Su):]{icon=def immediate="The magus can sacrifice 1 or more points from his arcane pool to reflect a spell back at its caster. This functions as ‹spell/spell turning›, but only if the targeted spell is of a level equal to or lower than the number of points expended. If insufficient points are expended, they instead grant an insight bonus on any saving throws allowed by the spell, equal to the number of points spent." prereq="15th-level magus"}

rod_mastery.name: Rod Mastery
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55›

::ab[Rod Mastery (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus uses a rod, he calculates the DC for any spell it contains using his Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) instead of the minimum modifier needed to cast a spell of that level."}

rod_wielder.name: Rod Wielder
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55›

::ab[Rod Wielder (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus adds his Intelligence bonus (minimum 0) on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance when using a spell contained within a rod or when making a *spellstrike* attack channeled through a rod."}

scroll_mastery.name: Scroll Mastery
description: ‹SOURCE Magical Marketplace/4›

::ab[Scroll Mastery (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus uses a scroll, he may expend 1 point from his arcane pool to allow him to calculate the DC for any spell contained on the scroll using his Intelligence modifier, instead of the minimum modifier needed cast a spell of that level." prereq="6th-level magus"}

silent_magic.name: Silent Magic
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Silent Magic (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can cast one spell per day as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Silent Spell› feat. This does not increase the casting time or the level of the spell."}

spell_blending.name: Spell Blending
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Spell Blending (Ex):]{icon=learn ability="When a magus selects this arcana, he must select one spell from the ‹main/wizard spell« list› that is of a magus spell level he can cast. He adds this spell to his spellbook and list of magus spells known as a magus spell of its wizard spell level.~~~He can instead select two spells to add in this way, but both must be at least one level lower than the highest-level magus spell he can cast." special="A magus can select this magus arcana more than once."}

spell_shield.name: Spell Shield
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›
::ab[Spell Shield (Su):]{icon=def immediate="The magus can expend a point from his arcane pool to grant himself a shield bonus to AC equal to his Intelligence bonus until the end of his next turn."}

spell_trickery.name: Spell Trickery
description: ‹SOURCE Blood of the Moon/21›

::ab[Spell Trickery (Ex):]{icon=magic ability="When the magus successfully performs a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver, he can cast an illusion or enchantment spell he has prepared with a casting time of 1 standard action or less as a @HLswift_action." usage="Once per day" prereq="12th-level magus"}

spellbreaker.name: Spellbreaker
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55›
::ab[Spellbreaker (Ex):]{icon=power ability="The magus gains ‹feat/Spellbreaker› as a bonus feat." prereq="9th-level magus"}

spell_scars.name: Spell-Scars
description: ‹SOURCE Blood of the Moon/21›

::ab[Spell-Scars (Ex):]{icon=magic ability="The magus can use special scar-based tattoos called spell-scars on his skin to cast or prepare spells, much like scrolls. He can cast a spell from a spell-scar exactly like casting from a scroll; the ink and scars vanish when the spell is cast. The magus can also prepare spells from his spell-scars without expending them, similar to a wizard using the ‹feat/Spell Mastery› feat." special="The magus does not need to be able to see his spell-scar to use it. A magus has room on his skin for 18 total spell levels of spell-scars, which he can create using the rules for ‹rule/creating>scribing» scrolls› (although they do not require the ‹feat/Scribe Scroll› feat)."}

still_magic.name: Still Magic
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Still Magic (Su):]{icon=boost ability="The magus can cast one spell per day as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Still Spell› feat. This does not increase the casting time or the level of the spell."}

tabriss_step.name: Tabris's Step
description: ‹SOURCE Disciple's Doctrine/9›

::ab[Tabris's Step (Sp):]{icon=magic swift="A magus can spend 1 point from his arcane pool and gain the effects of a ‹spell/water walk› spell for 10 minutes per magus level. If he expends 2 points from his arcane pool, he can affect a total number of touched creatures equal to his magus level." prereq="6th-level magus"}

throwing_magus.name: Throwing Magus
description: ‹SOURCE Ranged Tactics Toolbox/13›

::ab[Throwing Magus:]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he can spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add the ‹magic-enh/returning› and ‹magic-enh/throwing› abilities to the list of available weapon special abilities.~~~When the magus throws a weapon enhanced by his arcane pool and hits a foe, he regains 1 arcane pool point. The magus can regain a number of arcane pool points per day equal to his Intelligence modifier in this way." special="If he throws his held weapon and draws another in the same round, he can enhance the newly drawn weapon with his arcane pool as a @HLfree_action instead of a swift action."}

vision_clouding_strike.name: Vision-Clouding Strike
description: ‹SOURCE Agents of Evil/25›

::ab[Vision-Clouding Strike:]{icon=boost-def swift="The magus can expend 1 or more points from his arcane pool to empower his weapon with shadowy energy that dissipates within 1 minute. A creature struck with the weapon must succeed at a Will save (DC = 1/2 the magus's level + his Intelligence modifier) or treat the magus as being in an area of ‹rule/dim light› for 1d4 rounds, plus 1 additional round for each arcane pool point expended. ‹spell/True seeing› penetrates this effect, but darkvision and similar darkness-penetrating effects do not." prereq="9th-level magus"}

wand_mastery.name: Wand Mastery
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›

::ab[Wand Mastery (Su):]{icon=boost ability="Whenever the magus uses a wand, he calculates the DC for any spell it contains using his Intelligence modifier, instead of the minimum modifier needed to cast a spell of that level."}

wand_wielder.name: Wand Wielder
description: ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/12›
::ab[Wand Wielder (Su):]{icon=power ability="The magus can activate a wand or staff in place of casting a spell when using spell combat."}
